tools.name: fit_results
tools.description: The lab's USL fit as it stands: alpha, beta and lambda with their 90% ranges, the peak load and peak throughput (or the ceiling when there is no peak), R squared, the typical error, the highest measured load and the units. Use it for any question about the curve, the peak or the limits.

tools.name: data_checks
tools.description: The lab's checks of the data, each with its level (ok, warn or bad), title and detail: too few runs, a missing steady state, points off the curve and the like. Use it to say how far the fit can be trusted.

tools.name: measurements
tools.description: The runs the fit rests on, from the lowest load: load, throughput, response time when given, and whether the fit flags the run as off the curve; at most 50 rows from from_row. Use it to point at particular runs.

tools.name: system_description
tools.description: What the user wrote about the system under test (up to 1,000 characters), or that they wrote nothing. Use it before naming likely causes.
